W.note: Flat primitives in spectrum colours on a soft gradient with Figma-style selection handles on the square; all keyframes return to rest so the 5 s seam is clean, with reduced-motion holding the frame-0 layout.

X.note: Reassembles the five pieces of the Figma mark in its exact colours, which copies the logo the brief forbids, and the backOut start gives a small velocity kink at the seam.

Y.note: Dark glow field with the Figma mark assembling, bursting and reassembling is energetic and seamless, but it reproduces the logo's geometry and palette rather than a fresh brand visual.

Z.note: Stripe-pattern blob, morphing handle and starburst give an airy primitive composition with a clear beat plan, but the starburst is not 90-degree symmetric so it snaps at the seam and the ground shows a hard letterbox edge.
